description: Walk-forward optimized market-neutral blend of the five validated components (equity TSM pure, equity DN low-beta, futures TSM 18m, futures realized-roll-yield carry, macro momentum). Close-to-close convention, class-appropriate base costs, 504-day formation / 21-day rebalance / 63-day step.
execution_fidelity_note: The first E042 execution (committed 2026-10-13 00:55Z) ran the primary with n_grid=2000, which adds a seeded Dirichlet(1) grid that selects the max-Sharpe feasible draw - turning min_var into an in-sample random search that does NOT replicate the E041 sensitivity-grid config (n_grid=0) that produced the 0.979 lead. This corrected re-run uses n_grid=0 as the pre-registered primary (faithful replication of the config under test) and keeps the n_grid=2000 variant as a reported diagnostic. The G2 placebo is the pre-registered BETA-CONSTRAINED null (Dirichlet draws projected onto the beta<=0.05 cap); the unconstrained placebo is a diagnostic. FE2 is the pre-registered OOS variance reduction vs 1/N (re-defined for min_variance per the E042 task spec), not the E041 in-sample Sharpe edge.

pre_registered.beta_constraints: |beta vs SPY| <= 0.05 AND |beta vs equal-weight de-seamed futures index| <= 0.05
pre_registered.optimizer: Ledoit-Wolf (2004) shrinkage covariance (scaled-identity target), ridge lambda=1e-4, SLSQP (n_grid=0: no Dirichlet grid overlay - faithful replication of the E041 grid config)

falsification_expectations.FE1: pairwise |corr| <= 0.5 for >= 80% of the 10 component pairs (full-sample)
falsification_expectations.FE2: OOS annualized variance(opt) <= 0.90 * OOS annualized variance(1/N) over the union of test folds (re-defined for min_variance per the E042 task spec; the E041 in-sample Sharpe edge does not apply because min_var is expected to be below 1/N in-sample by construction)

pre_registered.placebo: 50 sims; Dirichlet(1) component-weight draws PROJECTED onto the beta<=0.05 cap via SLSQP/LP at each rebalance (beta-constrained component-permutation null, matched to the constraint), same rebalance/execution/cost structure

sensitivity_grid.note: reported, not gated; no post-hoc selection

robustness: component-set ablation (all-5 vs macro-inclusive-3) via the sensitivity grid
split-half stability of the min-variance weights
implementation_gaps: 5 components (not 'many assets'); 1/N is the natural null
components are validated strategies with embedded internal costs, not raw factors

fe2_variance_reduction.definition: OOS annualized variance(opt) <= 0.90 * OOS annualized variance(1/N) over the union of test folds (re-defined for min_variance per the E042 task spec)
fe2_variance_reduction.context_note: E041-style in-sample Sharpe edge; min_var is expected to be BELOW 1/N in-sample by construction, so this is context only, not the pre-registered FE2.

diagnostic_dirichlet_grid_overlay.note: NOT the pre-registered primary. The seeded Dirichlet(1) grid selects the max-Sharpe feasible draw, turning min_var into an in-sample random search. This is the estimator the first E042 execution (2026-10-13 00:55Z) used by mistake; kept as a diagnostic to quantify the overlay's OOS cost.

convention_findings.finding: The dollar_neutral_longshort_weights construction (used as-is per the pre-registered component spec) is market-neutral under the OVERNIGHT convention (beta -0.035, the convention under which E012/E013 validated it) but carries a large POSITIVE equity beta under the v1.2.3 close-to-close convention (beta ~ +1.0). E024 audited the dn_lowbeta Sharpe under both conventions (c2c 1.053 / overnight 1.289) but did not re-measure its beta under c2c. This convention-dependence is a primary reason the blend cannot reach |beta vs SPY| <= 0.1 out-of-sample: the component believed to be a market-neutral diversifier is a high-beta equity sleeve under c2c.
convention_findings.dollar_neutral_longshort_weights_directi: As implemented, dollar_neutral_longshort_weights sizes the k largest rank-percentiles long and the k smallest short; under rank(ascending=False) the largest signal maps to the smallest percentile, so the book is long the smallest-signal (highest-beta) names and short the largest-signal (lowest-beta) names - the reverse of the docstring's 'long the top by signal' and of the low-beta strategy intent. Used as-is (pre-registered); recorded here because it determines the component's c2c beta sign.

placebo_constrained.definition: Beta-constrained component-permutation null (PRIMARY G2): Dirichlet(1) draws projected onto the beta<=0.05 cap at each rebalance via SLSQP/LP, same rebalance/execution/cost structure

placebo_unconstrained.definition: Unconstrained Dirichlet(1) null (DIAGNOSTIC): biased against the constraint - a negative z measures the Sharpe cost of the market-neutrality constraint, not a lack of component edge

comparison.stability_note: Small L1 / high rank correlation between half-mean weights indicates the min_variance solution is stable across sample splits (unlike the E041 max_sharpe solution, which was non-monotonic in the beta cap).

sensitivity_market_neutral_summary.multiple_testing_note: 6 of 96 pre-registered sensitivity configs achieve |beta vs SPY| <= 0.1 with OOS Sharpe >= 0.8. These are EXPLORATORY (the grid is reported, not gated); selecting any of them for promotion would be post-hoc multiple-testing and requires a dedicated pre-registered confirmatory run with a full placebo test (G2) before any promotion.
